capabilities: Track semesters, classes, lectures, assignments and exams
Calculate a class grade from type weights and entered scores
Track attendance against an optional minimum
Show a combined calendar, Today sidebar and daily note agenda
Export syllabi, calendar files, CSV and JSON backups
disambiguation: Not a navigation or habit-streak tool; it records academic semesters, classes and coursework.
extras: All data lives in data.json in the plugin folder; no accounts or syncing. Reminders only fire while Obsidian is open, and on mobile only while it is in front. The README notes the plugin is a planning tool, not a gradebook for a class roster.
motivation: The author, a self-learner working through courses on their own schedule, found that a system of lists grew into its own job and wanted an academic tracker that lives inside the vault next to their notes.
problem: Syllabi and coursework do not fit cleanly into task lists, so tracking lectures, readings and due dates across several classes becomes a job of its own.

relations.evidence: With the Tasks plugin on, work in progress is written [/].

summary: Academic tracker for semesters, classes, lectures, assignments, exams, grades, attendance and reading lists, with calendar and Today views.
